QuestInfo.name: A Legend Forever
QuestInfo.0: What does Lupamo want to give you in return? Listen and find out.
QuestInfo.1: Since you're looking for knowledge of the ancient gods, Lupamo has offered to share the stories Carcion has told about them.
QuestInfo.2: Lupamo told the story of an ancient god that attacked Keira, and Carcion, in the past. Not all gods, Lupamo said, are big and powerful; some are small and subtle, and you might find them in places you wouldn't expect.
